build_sweep_scripts: build SLURM batch scripts from a sweep config file for grid search over hyperparameters
run_grid_search: run a grid search by generating sbatch scripts for each combination of varying arguments
create_sweep_config: create a sweep config file with key=value pairs where comma-separated values generate grid combinations
generate_master_script: generate a master shell script that submits all individual sbatch job scripts in parallel
review_sweep_config_parsing: review the sweep config file parsing logic that splits key=value lines and handles comments
